defects.fix: Cut section shorter or show one more concrete artifact (test name pass).

defects.problem: Thumbnail of the redacted screen is tiny and unreadable, and the four statements stay at similar weight, with the active one only slightly bolder.
defects.fix: Enlarge the thumbnail or drop it; make the active line stronger.

defects.problem: Large empty band under the five code lines.
